name: Single-Arm Cable Kickback with Pause
description: A cable kickback variation with a deliberate pause at peak extension to maximize triceps contraction. The cable provides constant tension unlike dumbbells that lose it at the top. The pause increases time under tension for superior muscle growth.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Single-Arm Cable Kickback with Pause in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Single-Arm Cable Kickback with Pause.
steps: Step 1: Attach single handle to low cable. Hinge forward with back flat.
Step 2: Keep upper arm parallel to floor and extend elbow behind you.
Step 3: Hold the peak contracted position for 2 full seconds.
Step 4: Return arm slowly to bent position and repeat.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Dropping upper arm during the pause
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Squeeze hard and count the pause
